title: 芰荷香 Jihe Xiang
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: A plain box on the block drawn on the Qing plan S01: position and frontage from the plan, heights and roof from the typology of its hall class. It will be updated as the research goes on.
rows: platform 0.45 m, eave 3.2 m, ridge 6.21 m above the ground
gable 硬山 or 悬山, rolled ridge 卷棚, grey tile

evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 多稼如云
evidence.excerpt_zh: 濓溪樂處迤北對河外稻塍者為多稼如雲正宇五楹前宇為芰荷香正宇東稍南有室為湛緑（圓明園册）臣等謹按多稼如雲四十景之一軒額興芰荷香湛緑皆御書
evidence.summary: North of 濓溪樂處, facing paddies across the stream: 多稼如雲, a five-bay main range, 芰荷香 in front and 湛緑 to the east.

evidence.title: 芰荷香北望
evidence.locator: v2 p.229, under 多稼如云; source ref 2-105
evidence.excerpt_zh: 蜃窗纳远景，春宇绘闲云。老树留曦影，轻风叠水纹。岚光相映带，淑霭互氤氲。农作期将近，耕畬事克勤。
evidence.summary: Poem 芰荷香北望 by the Jiaqing Emperor, 1802, filed by the editors under 多稼如云.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum and Historical Photographs of China; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 芰荷香, 3x1 cells.
